name: Embodied Agent Interface
description: Embodied Agent Interface is a generalized benchmark framework for evaluating Large Language Models in embodied decision making. It unifies a broad set of embodied decision-making tasks, LLM-based modules for decision making, and fine-grained metrics that break down various error types, enabling comprehensive assessment of LLMs' strengths and weaknesses in embodied AI systems.
reputation: A recent unified framework for embodied decision-making evaluation that is promising in research settings but not yet broadly established as a standard benchmark.
notes: Provides a unified interface and fine-grained metrics to pinpoint specific error types in embodied decision making tasks.
